name: KyRecovery
description: Encrypted backup store for the Ky Suite apps, with recovery cards you keep.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the stored backups (capsules/), the server key (secret.key) and initial-admin-password. Copy the whole folder somewhere else too: it is the backup of your other Ky apps.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyRecovery web app and deposit API, published on host as 6698

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KYRECOVERY_DATA_DIR
variables.description: Where KyRecovery keeps its data inside the container. Leave it as /app/data.
